name: Works of Antoni Gaudí
description: Seven buildings by Antoni Gaudí, almost all in Barcelona, show off the Catalan architect's wildly original style. Look for Park Güell's mosaic-covered benches and the rippling stone facade of Casa Milà. Gaudí also worked on the Sagrada Família's Nativity facade and crypt. Nature-inspired shapes, ceramic fragments and handcrafted ironwork turn each building into a sculpture you can walk through.
